A fly saw a dark sky. The fly was shy. It did not try to fly. Then, the sun came out, and it was dry. The fly said, “I will try!” The fly flew to the sky, and it did not cry. Una mosca vio un cielo oscuro. La mosca era tímida. No intentó volar. Luego, salió el sol y afuera estaba seco. La mosca dijo: “¡Voy a intentarlo!”. La mosca voló hacia el cielo y no lloró.
